table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,    
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledgermodified.CustRefNo, 
       date = CASE lower(:as_datetype)  
							When 'originaldate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate) 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.date)
							When 'billingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate)
				  End,  
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,
		 orderno = dbo.saleledgermodified.custrefno,
       remarks = dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks,
       custcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode,
		 manufacturer = max(dbo.manufacturer.name),
		 looseqty = sum(dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty), 
		 itemflatdisc=max(dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc),
       packqty  = sum(saledetailmodified.packqty),  
       packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS null Then space(30) else max(dbo.itempacking.name) end,
       price =max( dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice),    
       itemdiscperc = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc),    
		 packunits = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.packunits),    
		 batch = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.batch),    
		 expiry = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.expiry),    
		 salestax  =max( saledetailmodified.salestax),
		 rowid     = max(saledetailmodified.rowid),
	 	 itemname = CASE max(saledetailmodified.Claimable) When 'Y' THEN max(dbo.itempacking.name) Else item.name END,
		 itemalias = max(item.customicode),
/*		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledgermodified.date)))), */
		 Person = 'M/S. ' + dbo.accounts.name ,
		 address1 =max( dbo.customer.address1),
		 address2 = max(dbo.customer.address2),
		 city = max(dbo.customer.city),
		 phone = max(dbo.customer.phone), 	
      doctype = Case max(dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode) When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
		
		 invnettotal= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Round(Sum (  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01))) * ( SL.discperc /100), 2)
												 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledgermodified SL , 
         			dbo.saledetailmodified SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,   
							 SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)


FROM 	 dbo.saleledgermodified, 
		 dbo.saledetailmodified,    
		 dbo.item
		 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
		 dbo.manufacturer,
		 dbo.accounts,
		 dbo.customer

WHERE  CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
		 End  Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
		 (dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode >= ( Case :al_CustCode When 0 Then 10 Else :al_CustCode End) and 
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode  <= ( Case :al_CustCode When 0 THEN (Select max(custcode) From Customer) Else :al_CustCode End )) and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		/* dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode NOT IN (select distinct srledger.saleinvcode from srledger where srledger.date between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and srledger.saleinvcode IS NOT NULL) and*/
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode and 
		 item.manfcode = manufacturer.manfcode and
       dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode

GROUP BY saleledgermodified.saleinvcode, 
         CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
		   End , 
			saleledgermodified.originaldate,
			saleledgermodified.billingdate,
			/*saleledgermodified.headerno,*/
			saleledgermodified.custcode, 
			saleledgermodified.discperc, 
			saleledgermodified.flatdisc, 
			saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
			saleledgermodified.salestax, 
			saleledgermodified.custrefno,
			saleledgermodified.remarks,
			saleledgermodified.custrefno, 
			saledetailmodified.icode,
			saledetailmodified.rowgroup, 
			saledetailmodified.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.packcode,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name
	
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL)
table.sort: person A, saleinvcode A, rowid A

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: Round (  looseqty  * ( price  -  itemflatdisc)  *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) , 2) +( itemflatdisc* looseqty)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  , 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  For Group 2 ) ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 2)

objects.name: c_invdiscountvalue
objects.expression: Sum (( ((  looseqty   *  price  )   - (looseqty * itemflatdisc) )*  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) for group 2 )  *  ( Sum(invdiscperc for group 2 distinct saleinvcode) * .01)
